eyebrow: One shared entry point, not one per app

steps.label: Cost & sprawl
steps.sub: a separate billed load balancer for every app

steps.label: Ingress
steps.sub: L7 routing rules by host and path, one shared IP

steps.label: Ingress Controller
steps.sub: the Pod that actually enforces those rules

code:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: northbridge-ingress
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  rules:
    - host: catalog.northbridge.example
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: product-catalog
                port:
                  number: 80
caption: The Ingress is just a rulebook — ingressClassName ties it to the controller that actually proxies traffic.

code:
spec:
  tls:
    - hosts:
        - catalog.northbridge.example
      secretName: catalog-tls-cert
caption: The Ingress Controller decrypts HTTPS using the cert in this Secret, then forwards plain HTTP internally.
